title: Chapter 36 Zerg Second Base
content:
Chapter 36 Zerg Second Base

In Daxia Territory, the number of people who went to the wild to collect food increased a lot that day. The Zerg expanded the scope of hunting and hunted many animals.

Wu Qing found that feeding meat to the people was surprisingly effective in gathering people's hearts. For today's dinner, he planned to be extravagant and let everyone eat meat.

Various wild animals in the wild in this world can be said to be rampant, but ordinary people cannot go hunting in the wild. It is not that they have no choice, but no one will risk their lives just for some meat.

Moreover, prey in the wild may not be hunted without some strength and experience.

It is very easy for people with real strength to eat meat.

This is also the reason why most lords do not develop animal husbandry. There are prey everywhere outside. If you want to eat, just send people to hunt. How troublesome is it to raise it yourself?

Even if Wu Qing learned about this situation, he did not plan to vigorously develop animal husbandry.

Today, the Zerg deliberately hunted a large herd of bison. These herds of bison, which were usually not dared to be provoked by anything, suffered a catastrophe.

If Wu Qing had not stopped the Zerg from slaughtering them at will and intended to let the bison herd continue to reproduce, according to the nature of the Zerg, these bison would have been killed without a single one left.

It was very troublesome to transport a large number of heavy bison, and finally worker bees were dispatched to transport them all back to the city.

"Tonight's dinner, the lord invites everyone to eat beef together!"

Hearing this notice and seeing the bison being transported into the city, all the people in the territory were full of gratitude and expectations.

Even those refugees who did not join the Great Xia Territory were somewhat looking forward to it, because this notice did not specifically exclude them.

The refugees who did not join the Great Xia Territory were basically people of a certain status, and they must have eaten meat frequently. Now they have fallen to this point, eating some food made of unknown things every day, which is very uncomfortable.

Now it is a luxury to have a meal of meat.

There are about 9,000 people in the entire territory. With so many people eating meat, it is definitely impossible to cook meat, and there are not so many pots.

There is only one way, that is to roast!

Beef can be eaten by just roasting it casually.

Many people stopped their work and joined the team that processed and roasted beef.

The current conditions were simple and many daily necessities were not available. Wu Qing had already used worker bees to transport the supplies of the bear goblins captured on the battlefield.

Those that can be used directly can be used, and those that cannot be used directly should be transformed or recycled.

Now Daxia has talents in all aspects, and it is not difficult to do these things.

These things can be distributed as rewards for the work of the people in the territory to improve their living standards.

As long as the Zerg fights, the enemy will deliver what they need.

In the evening, the foundations of the new city wall and the residential area were dug, and some frames of the houses in the residential area were built.

This is thanks to the super excavators such as worker bees. Whether it is hard rock or muddy water, they have no effect on them. They are extremely efficient and can dig and transport. A worker bee can easily dig a long distance of the city wall foundation.

If it is dug manually, I don’t know when it will be dug.

With the help of worker bees, tasks such as cutting rocks and carrying heavy objects can be done quickly and well.

The beaver tribe leader in charge of building the city patted his chest and promised that as long as more worker bees came to help, he would build the city wall and residential area within ten days!

The progress of the city construction was gratifying, and Wu Qing was willing to give out meat. Even the refugees who did not join the Great Xia Territory received a portion of beef.

Although the portion could not be compared with that of the people of the Great Xia Territory, it also won the favor of many refugees.

In such a chaotic world, it is good for ordinary people to be alive and have something to eat. It is really a very happy thing to be able to eat meat like this.

After eating and drinking, many people gathered together to chat. After a day of working together, many people became familiar with each other.

What they talked about most was the Great Xia Territory and the mysterious lord, as well as some aspirations for the future.

"It's not easy to meet a good lord!"

This is what everyone thought in their hearts, but they would not say it out loud.

Everyone understood.

The fortune of the Great Xia Territory is rising again.

Wu Qing was generous again and gave the daily necessities seized from the battlefield as a reward for today's work, which was a disguised gift to the people.

The refugees who had just joined the Great Xia Territory really had nothing. It was not a good idea for Wu Qing to keep the daily necessities in his hand, so he took them out for everyone to use.

As long as he gave a portion to the original people in the city, he would treat them equally.

Wu Qing's actions once again proved everyone's evaluation of him.

So many refugees, in the impoverished Great Xia Territory, were completely at ease in just two days.

If you are willing to give up, you will get what you give up!

Wu Qing had a deep understanding of this sentence.

…

It was late at night. After the Zerg army had brushed off several waves of weirdness, only the hosts and dogs patrolling the weakened area of the Lord's shelter were left, and faint sounds of fighting were heard occasionally.

With the protection of the Zerg, the people who had been tired for a day fell asleep peacefully.

The Zerg units without tasks all hid underground to restore their own energy.

In the core area of the new city, the large hole in the middle has been reinforced by worker bees and has become a spacious entrance and exit.

The entrance and exit are surrounded by rocks, blocking the view from the outside world.

Underground in the core area, all the worker bees that came to Daxia Territory continued to work busily.

Zerg worker bees can absorb some energy from various materials mined, and natural solar energy, spiritual energy, etc. can also replenish their consumption.

Zerg units can automatically and efficiently absorb various energies, so they rarely need to rest or food, and can continue to work and fight.

Of course, fierce battles cannot continue, as such excessive consumption will affect the various body functions of the Zerg.

At this time, you can return to the Zerg organic spread for rapid energy replenishment, or you can drill underground to rest and recover slowly.

In the underground space, the worker bees have dug out enough space to build Zerg buildings.

The caves dug by the Zerg, like many underground nests built by mixed insects, have their own stable characteristics. It is very safe to build Zerg buildings underground.

Moreover, the Zerg has its own drilling skills, so it is not afraid of being buried. It can be said that the underground is the most ideal safe base for the Zerg.

Wu Qing controlled a worker bee and came to the center of the underground space, where he pupated and built the first mother nest of the underground territory.

Soon, the first mother nest appeared underground in the new city of Daxia Territory. In this world, the Zerg finally had a second base.

The mother nest here can continue to produce worker bees to open up underground space in order to build more Zerg buildings and develop Zerg bases.

The excavated rock and soil are just right for building cities on the ground, without the need to find a quarry on the ground to quarry stones.

As the number of worker bees in the underground space increases, important Zerg buildings are built one by one, and Daxia Territory will be able to develop and ensure the safety of the territory without the support of the Zerg territory.

The Zerg territory in the forest will focus on dealing with foreign enemies.
